meta.title: The empty-list message can be read in full

steps.note: Open the Purchase Requisitions area where the DLF UAT open PRs are listed.
Limit the list to open PRs that can be selected.
Select one open PR containing a single item, matching the test setup before assigning.

args.goal: On the selected purchase requisition item, click Assign, type a name that matches no vendor or person, and stop with the complete empty-list message visible and readable on screen

steps.note: Perform the assignment search and directly verify that the full no-match message is visible.
Confirm the resulting screen has no crash, server error, raw identifiers, or rendering artifacts while the message is displayed.
